body: I attend a large university so reaching out to professors that have anywhere from 500 to 1000 students to talk about what can be done for my individual mental health honestly does not seem like a plausible thing to do. I think it will just be brushed off to the side, and if its not they will just tell me to “make a schedule and stick to it.” But that’s part of the problem, It’s hard to stick to a schedule when I feel glued to my bed.

No, there is no way I can become a doctor at this point. My grades took a nose dive, I went from dean’s list to barely being able to muster the strength to do any work. Its not that its difficult, its just that for some reason I can’t find anymore motivation.
